LS.dated: Income Tax Act 1993 consolidated to 1 April 2012 (the copy the Revenue Services Lesotho site publishes as its current Act, uploaded 2024); later Finance Acts not held: grade B, flagged
LS.sources_add: RSL pages and guides fetched 2026-11-21 (`cmp20/global/R4/fetch/ls8/`, SHA256SUMS): withholding tax guide, VAT Act 2001, VAT (Amendment) Regulations LN 18 of 2020 and LN 30 of 2021 (OCR).

cit.name: Company income tax
cit.statute: Income Tax Act 1993 s. 10 and Third Schedule item 4 (other income 25 %; substituted by Act No. 2 of 2007), consolidation to 1 April 2012 as published by the RSL; amendments 2013-2025 not held (flagged)
cit.doc: Third Schedule (section 10), Resident Company Income Tax Rates: "1. Manufacturing income derived from a manufacturing activity of an industrial, scientific or educational nature which promotes industrial, scientific, educational or other development within Lesotho 10% ... 3. Other manufacturing income 10% 4. Other income 25%" [Third Schedule substituted by sec. 3 of Act No. 2 of 2007]; s. 2: "standard rate of tax" means a rate of 25%. The RSL 'corporate income tax' page (2026) still attaches this consolidation. Grade B flagged: no Finance Act after 2012 was read.
notes: manufacturing income 10 % (0 % for exports outside SACU) is not separable; advance corporation tax on distributions (33,33 %, creditable) not modelled

wht.name: Withholding on payments to non-residents
wht.statute: Income Tax Act 1993 s. 107 (1) (standard rate 25 % on dividends, interest, royalties, natural resource payments and management charges paid to non-residents) and s. 108 (1) (10 % on services contracts), consolidation to 1 April 2012; RSL withholding tax guide; later amendments not held (flagged)
wht.doc: s. 107 (1): "withholding tax at the standard rate of tax is payable on the gross amount of a Lesotho-source dividend, interest, royalty, natural resource payment, or management charge paid to a non-resident"; (3): 15 % where the payment relates to concessionary manufacturing income; s. 108 (1): "Withholding tax at the rate of 10% is payable on the gross amount of a payment under a Lesotho-source services contract paid to a non-resident"; s. 109 (1): final tax. RSL Withholding Tax Guide table: "Dividends 25% ... Interest 25% ... Management Fee 25% ... Royalty 25%".
notes: management charges are at 25 % under s. 107 (s. 108 (2) excludes them from the 10 % services rate): the services line is taken as an ordinary services contract
dividends out of concessionary manufacturing income are exempt and related interest/royalties/fees are at 15 % (s. 107 (2)-(3)): not separable
